statements.query: MATCH (env:ElasticBeanstalkEnvironment)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE env.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH env LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE env.exposed_internet, env.exposed_internet_type, env.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: A web server environment's front door is its load balancer: public when one of its load balancers is exposed (set by aws_ec2_elb_asset_exposure.json, which must run first). An internal load balancer leaves it private. Worker environments only pull from SQS, so they are never public.
statements.query: MATCH (env:ElasticBeanstalkEnvironment)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE coalesce(env.tier_name, 'WebServer') <> 'Worker' MATCH (env)-[:USES_LOAD_BALANCER]->(lb) WHERE lb.exposed_internet = true WITH env, collect(DISTINCT {name: lb.name, dnsName: lb.dnsname, scheme: lb.scheme, exposureTypes: lb.exposed_internet_type}) AS loadBalancers SET env.exposed_internet = true, env.exposed_internet_type = ['load_balancer'], env.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: env.id, resourceType: 'aws-compute-elasticbeanstalk-environment', context: [{environmentName: env.name, environmentId: env.environment_id, applicationName: env.application_name, region: env.region, cname: env.cname, endpointUrl: env.endpoint_url, tier: coalesce(env.tier_name, 'WebServer'), environmentType: env.environment_type, exposureTypes: ['load_balancer'], loadBalancers: loadBalancers}]}])

statements.__comment: A web server environment without a load balancer (single instance) is served by its instance's Elastic IP: public when one of its instances is exposed (set by aws_ec2_instance_asset_exposure.json, which must run first).
statements.query: MATCH (env:ElasticBeanstalkEnvironment)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE coalesce(env.tier_name, 'WebServer') <> 'Worker' AND env.exposed_internet IS NULL AND size(coalesce(env.load_balancer_names, [])) = 0 MATCH (env)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->(instance:EC2Instance) WHERE instance.exposed_internet = true WITH env, collect(DISTINCT {instanceId: instance.id, publicIp: instance.publicipaddress, exposureTypes: instance.exposed_internet_type}) AS instances SET env.exposed_internet = true, env.exposed_internet_type = ['instance'], env.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: env.id, resourceType: 'aws-compute-elasticbeanstalk-environment', context: [{environmentName: env.name, environmentId: env.environment_id, applicationName: env.application_name, region: env.region, cname: env.cname, endpointUrl: env.endpoint_url, tier: coalesce(env.tier_name, 'WebServer'), environmentType: env.environment_type, exposureTypes: ['instance'], instances: instances}]}])

statements.__comment: Fail-safe: a web server environment whose resources could not be read (resources_resolved false), or whose load balancer / instance is not in the graph, cannot be shown private, so it stays public. An environment that lists no load balancer and no instance has nothing behind its CNAME and is not flagged.
statements.query: MATCH (env:ElasticBeanstalkEnvironment)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE coalesce(env.tier_name, 'WebServer') <> 'Worker' AND env.exposed_internet IS NULL OPTIONAL MATCH (env)-[:USES_LOAD_BALANCER]->(lb) WITH env, collect(lb.arn) + collect(lb.name) AS linkedLoadBalancers OPTIONAL MATCH (env)-[:HAS_INSTANCE]->(instance:EC2Instance) WITH env, linkedLoadBalancers, collect(instance.id) AS linkedInstances WITH env, [n IN coalesce(env.load_balancer_names, []) WHERE NOT n IN linkedLoadBalancers] AS unresolvedLoadBalancers, CASE WHEN size(coalesce(env.load_balancer_names, [])) = 0 THEN [i IN coalesce(env.instance_ids, []) WHERE NOT i IN linkedInstances] ELSE [] END AS unresolvedInstances WHERE coalesce(env.resources_resolved, false) = false OR size(unresolvedLoadBalancers) > 0 OR size(unresolvedInstances) > 0 SET env.exposed_internet = true, env.exposed_internet_type = ['unresolved'], env.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: env.id, resourceType: 'aws-compute-elasticbeanstalk-environment', context: [{environmentName: env.name, environmentId: env.environment_id, applicationName: env.application_name, region: env.region, cname: env.cname, endpointUrl: env.endpoint_url, tier: coalesce(env.tier_name, 'WebServer'), environmentType: env.environment_type, exposureTypes: ['unresolved'], resourcesResolved: coalesce(env.resources_resolved, false), unresolvedLoadBalancers: unresolvedLoadBalancers, unresolvedInstances: unresolvedInstances}]}])
